Legacy builder/packets remain bounded; v2 explicit-row verification and downstream approved-row/text intake are disk-backed. Other mixture/lineage/BPE state is not globally bounded.

criteria.requirement: Scalable admission backed by representative human audit

criteria.requirement: Verified token shards, source counts and repeat exposure
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Processed, supervised and unique prepared positions differ; prior 2.6M reader probe has zero neural updates.

criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Candidate builder uses a checked text spool/generator and streaming record digest; BPE internal vocabulary state still grows. Retained synthetic comparison yielded 432 tokens for both requested sizes; no production selection.

criteria.requirement: Frozen production vocabulary selected from representative eligible data
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: No production candidate, selection or freeze. Vocabulary choice and target count must follow actual yield/efficiency.

criteria.requirement: Disjoint structural IDs, raw-content isolation and serialization
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: No raw content special-token interpretation; typed and continuation formats are versioned.

criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Requested Luna identity is pinned; CLI does not report resolved model identity.

criteria.requirement: Real small teacher pilot/cache/lineage/usage evidence
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: 14 successful candidates, two families; 17/20 reservations, no adapter-enforced settled-dollar cap.

criteria.requirement: Conversation/clarification/correction/style/tool/student-failure generation
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: All task shapes have fixture tests; real data is narrow arithmetic. Genuine trained-student failure mining is not demonstrated.

criteria.requirement: Human/rights/category-approved teacher data and broad validation
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: No actual account/source evidence, human approval or mature-category pilot. Surface-distinct style outputs are not meaning/style acceptance.

criteria.requirement: Executable host normalization and reviewed continuation masks
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Multiplication mapping only; partial historical tool exchanges unsupported. Historical assistant mistakes have zero direct loss.

criteria.requirement: Target architecture count and full-depth tiny-overfit checks
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Random initialization and synthetic checks only; full trajectory criterion still fails.

criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Reference runner now binds reviewed content, budgets, managed checkpoints and resume/stage receipts. Synthetic local tests are not the real language pilot; actual CUDA wrapper validation remains open.

criteria.requirement: Actual 1M-token English smoke training
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: No eligible production tokenizer/data or 1M neural-update run; synthetic reader positions do not meet this requirement.

criteria.requirement: Actual 10M-token laptop language pilot
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: No trained language checkpoint or sustained run. Short benchmark is not this pilot.

criteria.requirement: Sustained throughput/memory/restarts/checkpoint-overhead report

criteria.requirement: Authorized CUDA validation and retained cleanup records
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: USD 7 conservative allowance of USD 10 validation-only ceiling; settled billing unknown.

criteria.requirement: Actual staged 100M/1B/3B/10B evaluated checkpoints
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: No main pretraining performed; stages are planned experiments, not proof these token budgets suffice.

criteria.requirement: Measured complete cost per million useful training tokens
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Short synthetic T4 timing is not current complete instance pricing or sustained production economics.

criteria.requirement: Assistant-only/tool-call/termination masks and family grouping
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Mechanically tested masks; no actual conversation/style/tool SFT checkpoint.

criteria.requirement: Conversation SFT with general replay and measured regression
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Mixture support exists, but no 50K real approved conversation set or trained/reviewed baseline.

criteria.requirement: Meaning-preserving five styles and recovery across turns
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Teacher guidance/cues exist; no learned student capability or human accepted pair evaluation.

criteria.requirement: Independent SFW/mature content behavior and category approvals
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: No mature source inventory/actual training/suite approval; style labels do not imply content categories.

criteria.requirement: Five to ten supported tools and learned no-call/clarify/arguments

criteria.requirement: Dependent calls/preference tuning/RL only when justified
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Do not promote optional later techniques before single-call correctness and useful SFT.

criteria.requirement: Application-owned discovery/schema/execution/results/call limits
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Reference local handlers and bounded host integration; not unrestricted action authorization.

criteria.requirement: Actual MCP stdio and bounded Streamable HTTP transport
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Local SDK process/HTTP and retained CUDA scripted controls; production OAuth/authorization is not implemented.

criteria.requirement: Untrusted tool-result handling and first-attempt error reporting
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: No automatic outcome replay; missing result remains unknown. Model resistance is not proven by schema controls.

criteria.requirement: Learned end-to-end task completion on both deployment backends
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Scripted success and random-student negative controls are not a useful learned model.

criteria.requirement: ESCI splits/query families and retrieval/ranker comparison
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Correctly gated after core conversation/tool capability; no ESCI adapter/data/ranker experiment yet.

criteria.requirement: Domain replay, relevance/regression and full latency/memory
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: No core checkpoint exists to specialize or protect; do not substitute ESCI for language pretraining.

criteria.requirement: Quantized exports checked against unquantized learned reference
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: No accepted learned baseline or deployment-quality comparison; reference FP32 storage is not quantization.

criteria.requirement: 500 human-reviewed initial cases and accepted stage policy
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: 500 candidate cases exist, zero approved. Stage policy remains proposed.

criteria.requirement: Adequate held-out slice coverage, human rubrics and uncertainty
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Scoring/screens exist; no accepted mature suite, blind human grades or useful student behavior.

criteria.requirement: Tool/clarification/turn/meaning/style/unsupported-claim targets
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: 95%/95%/90%/90%/90% and <=1% unsupported-claim targets have no learned-model release evidence.

criteria.requirement: Constrained schema/raw-versus-constrained and repair comparisons
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Strict raw parsing/rejection and no-repair controls exist; no general constrained decoder or 99.5% learned-schema result.

criteria.requirement: M4 p95 latency and 2K total incremental inference memory
criteria.scope_or_missing_proof: Short training timing is neither p95 complete tool-generation latency nor full deployment memory.
